newsitem.title: UK: UK's Offer approves electricity codes of practice.
newsitem.headline: UK's Offer approves electricity codes of practice.

text.p: UK electricity industry watchdog Offer said on Thursday it had completed approval of new and revised Codes of Practice for all 14 public electricity suppliers in England, Scotland and Wales.
Offer head Stephen Littlechild said in a statement that the codes "reflect the needs of customers, particularly those on low incomes, and incorporate changes to individual companies' practices."
He called on companies to publish the codes quickly.

The statement said 56 codes had been approved covering services for customers with prepayment meters and revised codes to deal with payment problems as well as services for the elderly and disabled and efficient usage.
"These codes play a key role in setting out the services customers can expect from their electricity company," Littlechild said.
Offer said in May that it had approved new or revised codes for seven of the fourteen companies.
